t: The Sylvania Toledo Platinum E27 GLS LED light bulb offers efficient and reliable illumination for various settings. This efficient A-class LED filament lamp provides a warm white light, delivering 485 lumens with only 2.3W power consumption. It is ideal for everyday lighting in homes, hotels, and restaurants, offering an omni-directional light distribution. With a 50,000-hour average rated life, this non-dimmable bulb significantly reduces the need for frequent replacements.
